# EWS read-status updates name a single wire field and leave unrelated fields at defaults

Both the 2024 implementation and the accepted operation build SetItemField with message:IsRead and Message { is_read: Some(...), ..Default::default() }. The request uses SaveOnly. For this operation, preserve the explicit field path and optional-value form instead of constructing a full unrelated message update. This is a scoped Rust source pattern; actual XML output and server behavior were not tested. Vendored serialization syntax is an upstream wire contract, not a Thunderbird-wide style rule. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: EWS read-status request fields.
